title: QA Engineer Wireless RAN & Device
description:
Job Description: QA Engineer Wireless RAN & Device (LTE/5G/ Wi-Fi) 
 Role Overview 
 The QA Engineer – Wireless RAN & Device Validation is responsible for end-to-end validation of LTE and 5G Radio Access Network (RAN) solutions, ensuring feature compliance, RF performance, interoperability, and customer experience across commercial network deployments. The role involves validation of eNodeB/gNodeB, vRAN/ORAN platforms, radio features, RF performance, and protocol compliance, while also supporting validation of LTE/5G devices including smartphones and FWA CPEs to ensure seamless end-to-end interoperability between network and devices. The engineer will work closely with RAN & Device Engineering, Product, Network Operations, OEMs, and chipset vendors throughout the product lifecycle. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Define test strategy, test plans, test cases, and RTM for LTE/5G/WiFi RAN products and wireless solutions. Perform end-to-end validation of LTE/LTE-A/5G NR features, covering functional, protocol, RF, interoperability, performance, regression, and customer experience testing Validate Macro Cells, Small Cells, vRAN/ORAN, and eNB/gNB deployments in both lab and field environments Execute RF validation for TDD/FDD, OFDMA, Massive MIMO, Carrier Aggregation, Beamforming, Mobility, Handover, QoS, and Throughput Conduct acceptance testing, benchmarking, and standards compliance validation against 3GPP and O-RAN specifications Analyze Layer 1–3 logs and troubleshoot air interface, S1/X2/Xn, IMS, and interoperability issues through Root Cause Analysis Develop and maintain OTA and conducted test lines in Lab for end-to-end RAN, Core, and Device validation Validate LTE/5G commercial devices (Smartphones, FWA CPEs, and data devices) to ensure network interoperability and customer experience Collaborate with RAN strategy/ planning, Device Engineering, Network teams, OEMs, and chipset vendors for issue resolution and product quality improvements Drive test automation, manage the defect lifecycle, prepare technical documentation, and provide Go/No-Go recommendations for commercial releases. 
 Required Skills & Technical Expertise 
 Strong knowledge of LTE/LTE-A, 5G NR (NSA/SA),Wi-Fi(802.11ac/ax/be), vRAN, ORAN, IMS, RAN architecture, and 3GPP/O-RAN standards Good understanding of RF technologies including TDD/FDD, OFDMA, Massive MIMO, Beamforming, Carrier Aggregation, Mobility, Handover, QoS, and throughput optimization Hands-on experience in RAN feature, protocol, performance, KPI, capacity, stability, and interoperability testing Proficiency in RF and wireless test tools such as TM500, Keysight, Anritsu, QXDM, TEMS, XCAL, Wireshark, iPerf, and IxLoad Strong expertise in Layer 1–3 log analysis, protocol debugging (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS), and end-to-end call flow analysis Exposure to LTE/5G device validation (Smartphones, FWA CPEs, MiFi) with ADB and chipset debugging tools (Qualcomm/MediaTek/UNISOC) is an added advantage Knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages for test automation is desirable Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. 
 Experience & Qualifications 
 8–12 years of experience in LTE/5G RAN Testing, RF Validation, or Telecom Product QA. Hands-on experience in eNodeB/gNodeB, vRAN/ORAN, RAN feature validation, RF performance, protocol analysis, and interoperability testing. Experience in commercial acceptance testing and field validation of LTE/5G radio products. Exposure to LTE/5G device validation and end-to-end network-device integration will be an added advantage. Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related Engineering discipline.

Key Skills: 802.11,Wireshark,IxLoad,Anritsu,TEMS,Telecom,Keysight,ORAN

title: Deputy Manager - Product Development
description:
Work Timings: 10:15 am to 7:15 pm
 Working Days: 5 Days a Week (We Chose Work-Life Balance Over the Education Industry Norm)
 Work Mode: Work from Office
 Location: Marol, Mumbai
 
 About IIDE: IIDE is India's leading digital business school, offering industry-relevant programs in digital marketing, AI, and business. With a strong focus on experiential learning, we equip students, graduates, and working professionals with the skills required to thrive in today's digital-first world. Backed by a community of 500,000+ learners and 250+ industry experts, IIDE delivers hands-on training, real-world projects, and robust placement support. With campuses in Mumbai and Delhi, we continue to expand our presence across India and globally. 
 About the Role: As the Deputy Manager Product Development at IIDE Mumbai, you will own the technical execution of IIDE's product engineering function and lead a team of frontend and backend engineers. You will be responsible for taking products from business requirements and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and production. The role involves overseeing IIDE's product ecosystem, including the Learning Management System (LMS), Student and Admin Portals, public websites, backend services, APIs, internal applications, and third-party integrations. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role requiring strong technical depth, product thinking, delivery ownership, and people leadership. You will work closely with Product, Design, Technology, Marketing, CRM, Operations, and Business teams to build scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable technology products. 
 What You'll Do: Product Engineering Leadership: 
 Own engineering execution across IIDE's product development portfolio.
 Lead, mentor, and provide technical guidance to frontend and backend engineers.
 Establish engineering standards, coding practices, and development processes.
 Review technical designs, architecture, and implementation approaches.
 Ensure engineering decisions balance scalability, maintainability, security, performance, and delivery timelines.
 Build a culture of ownership, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
 Act as the technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges. 
 Product & Project Delivery: 
 Own end-to-end technical delivery across multiple concurrent product initiatives.
 Convert business and product requirements into clear technical execution plans.
 Break requirements into epics, modules, technical tasks, and development milestones.
 Estimate engineering effort and identify technical dependencies.
 Plan resources and assign work across the engineering team.
 Track delivery progress, risks, dependencies, blockers, and milestones.
 Work with Product and Business stakeholders to manage scope and technical trade-offs.
 Ensure releases are delivered on time without compromising engineering quality. 
 LMS & Product Platform Engineering: 
 Take technical ownership of IIDE's Learning Management System, Student Portal, Admin Portal, public websites, backend services, APIs, internal business applications, third-party integrations, and future technology initiatives.
 Play a key engineering role in the ongoing LMS rebuild using a modern technology stack.
 Ensure platform architecture can scale with IIDE's growing student and business requirements. 
 Architecture & System Design: 
 Design and review scalable application architectures across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
 Review database schemas, data models, queries, API contracts, and integration patterns.
 Evaluate technical approaches and recommend appropriate solutions.
 Identify architectural risks, technical dependencies, and scalability challenges early.
 Drive improvements in reliability, maintainability, application performance, and security.
 Establish appropriate authentication and authorization patterns.
 Identify and reduce technical debt.
 Ensure important architectural decisions are properly documented. 
 Engineering Quality & Production Reliability: 
 Establish and enforce code review standards.
 Ensure appropriate unit, integration, API, regression, and release testing practices.
 Review release readiness before production deployments.
 Improve application reliability and production stability.
 Own engineering-side incident investigation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
 Drive preventive actions following production incidents.
 Improve observability, logging, and monitoring practices.
 Maintain documentation for critical systems and engineering processes. 
 Technology Ownership: 
 Lead engineering teams working across Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, Next.js, React.js, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Git, and GitHub.
 Guide teams on software architecture, system design, database design, API design, authentication and authorization, integrations, microservices, caching, CI/CD, containers, cloud infrastructure, performance, and web security.
 Evaluate technologies based on their engineering and business value rather than adopting tools without a clear use case.
 Provide technical guidance across the stack without needing to personally be an expert in every technology. 
 Website & Technical Performance: 
 Ensure IIDE's Next.js websites follow modern engineering and performance practices.
 Work with Marketing and SEO teams to implement technical SEO requirements.
 Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals and frontend performance.
 Ensure applications are optimized for scalability, performance, and user experience.
 Ensure technical implementation supports crawlability, indexing, and other SEO requirements. 
 Engineering Team Management: 
 Conduct sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and engineering reviews.
 Mentor developers through technical guidance and regular feedback.
 Conduct code and architecture reviews.
 Identify skill gaps and create development plans for team members.
 Support technical hiring, interviews, and onboarding.
 Define clear ownership and responsibilities across the engineering team.
 Improve team productivity without compromising engineering quality.
 Build a strong culture of ownership, accountability, and problem-solving. 
 Cross-functional Collaboration: 
 Work closely with Product, Design, Marketing, CRM, Operations, and Business teams.
 Understand business problems before proposing technical solutions.
 Communicate technical constraints, dependencies, timelines, and trade-offs clearly.
 Partner with Product stakeholders on technical feasibility and solution design.
 Ensure engineering priorities remain aligned with business priorities.
 Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 Continuous Improvement: 
 Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and development processes.
 Automate repetitive engineering and deployment processes wherever possible.
 Improve development, testing, release, and deployment workflows.
 Reduce technical debt and recurring production issues.
 Evaluate new technologies where they provide meaningful business or engineering value.
 Encourage responsible adoption of AI-assisted development tools.
 Continuously improve system scalability, reliability, maintainability, and engineering efficiency. 
 Additional Duties: 
 Monitor technical risks and proactively resolve issues that could affect delivery or platform reliability.
 Contribute to future product and technology initiatives as IIDE's engineering ecosystem expands.
 Perform any other reasonable duties as requested by management, aligned with the broad scope of the position. 
 Who You Are: Must-Have: 
 5 - 7 years of software engineering experience.
 At least 1 - 2 years of experience leading engineers, projects, or technical initiatives.
 Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
 Strong understanding of Angular and modern frontend development.
 Experience working with REST APIs and PostgreSQL.
 Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, and database design.
 Experience delivering production applications used by real users.
 Experience managing multiple concurrent engineering initiatives.
 Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and release management.
 Experience with code reviews, debugging, production issue resolution, and incident management.
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
 Strong ownership and problem-solving mindset.
 Ability to balance product requirements, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
 Ability to mentor developers and improve overall team capability. 
 Should Have: 
 Strong understanding of API design, authentication and authorization, third-party integrations, microservices architecture, caching, application performance, CI/CD, Docker and containerisation, cloud infrastructure, and web security.
 Experience establishing engineering standards, testing practices, monitoring, logging, and release processes.
 Experience working in product companies, SaaS companies, EdTech, FinTech, high-growth technology companies, or startups with complex web platforms.
 Experience working with large-scale internal or customer-facing applications.
 Experience building or managing LMS, ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms, marketplaces, portals, or other multi-module business applications. 
 Nice to Have: 
 Experience with Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, message queues, or event-driven architecture.
 Exposure to AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean, or similar cloud platforms.
 Experience with monitoring and logging platforms.
 Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.
 Experience contributing to or leading large-scale platform modernization or rebuild initiatives. 
 Why Join IIDE? Lead engineering for one of India's leading EdTech organisations.
 Own technology for products used by thousands of students and business users.
 Play a key role in the redevelopment of IIDE's core LMS platform using modern technologies.
 Work across Spring Boot, Angular, Next.js, and modern backend systems.
 Take significant ownership of architecture, engineering standards, and product delivery.
 Work closely with senior business and technology leadership.
 Build and grow an engineering team as IIDE's technology requirements scale.
 Gain opportunities to take on larger technology leadership responsibilities over time. 
 Who You'll Thrive As You're someone who: Combines strong technical depth with product and business thinking.
 Enjoys taking ownership of engineering initiatives from requirements through production.
 Can lead engineers while remaining sufficiently hands-on to review architecture, code, and technical decisions.
 Thinks carefully about scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, and performance.
 Can convert ambiguous business requirements into structured technical execution plans.
 Communicates technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Enjoys mentoring developers and building high-performing engineering teams.
 Is comfortable managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
 Takes ownership of production issues and focuses on eliminating recurring problems at the root cause.
 Continuously looks for ways to improve engineering processes, systems, and team capability.
 Uses new technologies and AI-assisted development tools responsibly when they create meaningful value.

title: Walk-in || Project Manager
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 21 Sep - 10 Oct
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: MUMBAI
Contact: UnitedONE Construction (7220099988)

Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead and manage residential and commercial construction projects from pre-construction planning through completion and handover. The Project Manager will have overall responsibility for project execution, planning, cost, quality, safety, contracts, resources, coordination, and timely delivery . The role requires strong leadership and the ability to coordinate architects, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, vendors, engineers, and internal stakeholders. Role & responsibilities 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Project Planning & Execution Take overall responsibility for planning and execution of assigned residential and commercial construction projects. Develop detailed project execution plans, schedules, milestones, and resource requirements. Establish project objectives, deliverables, timelines, and construction strategies. Monitor progress against the approved project schedule and take corrective action where required. Ensure construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, contracts, and project requirements. Coordinate multiple construction activities and ensure proper sequencing of works. Drive the project from mobilization through construction, testing, snagging, completion, and final handover. 2. Design & Consultant Coordination Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, PMC, specialist consultants, and other design professionals. Review drawings and identify design discrepancies, constructability issues, and coordination requirements. Ensure timely release and approval of construction drawings and technical submittals. Coordinate RFI, design changes, shop drawings, material approvals, and technical clarifications. Ensure proper coordination between civil, structural, architectural, MEP, and finishing works. 3. Contractor & Subcontractor Management Manage and coordinate main contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and specialist agencies. Monitor contractor performance against contractual obligations, schedules, quality requirements, and manpower commitments. Conduct regular coordination and progress meetings with contractors. Resolve construction-related issues and escalate critical matters when required. Review contractor work programs, manpower deployment, material requirements, and recovery plans. Ensure adequate resources are deployed to maintain project schedules. 4. Cost & Commercial Management Monitor project costs against the approved budget. Work closely with the commercial/QS team on BOQs, measurements, variations, claims, and contractor payments. Review and control variations, additional works, and change orders. Support procurement and cost-control activities. Identify potential cost overruns and implement corrective measures. Ensure work is executed within the approved project budget. 5. Quality Management Ensure construction complies with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and quality standards. Establish and monitor project quality objectives and inspection procedures. Coordinate inspections, testing, approvals, and quality documentation. Ensure proper implementation of QA/QC procedures. Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive and corrective actions. Drive reduction of rework, defects, and construction wastage. 6. Health, Safety & Environment Ensure strict compliance with project HSE policies and applicable statutory requirements. Promote a strong safety culture across the project. Ensure contractors and subcontractors follow approved safety procedures. Monitor site safety performance and corrective actions. Participate in safety inspections, audits, and incident investigations. Ensure appropriate permits, PPE, access controls, and safe working practices are implemented. 7. Procurement & Materials Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely availability of construction materials and equipment. Review material requirements in line with the project schedule. Monitor material approvals, procurement, delivery, storage, and utilization. Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to minimize delays. Ensure materials comply with approved specifications and quality requirements. 8. Project Reporting & Documentation Prepare and review weekly and monthly project progress reports. Monitor project KPIs, milestones, productivity, cost, quality, and safety. Maintain project schedules, dashboards, risk registers, and action trackers. Conduct regular site walks and document progress and outstanding issues. Report major risks, delays, variations, and commercial issues to senior management. Maintain proper project records for approvals, correspondence, drawings, inspections, and handover documentation. 9. Client & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary project-level interface with clients and key stakeholders. Conduct regular client, consultant, and contractor meetings. Communicate project status, risks, delays, and recovery measures effectively. Manage expectations and ensure timely resolution of stakeholder concerns. Maintain professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, authorities, and vendors. 10. Handover & Project Close-Out Lead project completion, snagging, testing, and commissioning activities. Coordinate rectification of defects and outstanding works. Ensure completion documentation, as-built drawings, warranties, test certificates, and O&M manuals are submitted. Coordinate statutory approvals and completion requirements. Lead final handover to the client/owner. Conduct project close-out and document lessons learned. Residential & Commercial Construction Experience The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in projects involving some or all of the following: High-rise residential buildings Premium residential developments Villas and apartment projects Commercial office buildings Retail and shopping developments Hotels and hospitality projects Mixed-use developments Clubhouses and amenity buildings Basement and podium construction RCC framed structures Faade and external development works High-end architectural finishes MEP coordination and building services External infrastructure and landscaping Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution. Experience 1018 years of overall experience in building construction. Minimum 5 years in a Project Manager / Senior Project Manager / Construction Manager role preferred. Demonstrated experience managing medium to large-scale residential and/or commercial projects. Experience managing multiple contractors, consultants, and project teams. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of RCC and structural construction. Good understanding of architectural and RCC works. Project planning and scheduling. AutoCAD and drawing coordination. Quantity, BOQ, measurement, and cost-control knowledge. Contract and variation management. QA/QC systems and construction standards. Risk management and project reporting. MS Excel and other project management/reporting tools. Leadership & Behavioral Competencies Strong project leadership and decision-making ability. Excellent planning and organizational skills. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams. Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. Commercial awareness and cost-conscious approach. Proactive problem-solving mindset. Ability to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines. Strong attention to detail. High level of ownership and accountability. Ability to identify risks early and implement mitigation measures. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The Project Manager will be measured on: Project delivery against approved schedule. Project cost versus approved budget. Construction quality and defect levels. Safety performance. Contractor and subcontractor performance. Timely procurement and material availability. Design and consultant coordination. Reduction in rework and wastage. Timely closure of RFIs, approvals, variations, and site issues. Client/consultant satisfaction. Successful project handover and close-out. Authority & Accountability The Project Manager will be accountable for the overall performance of the assigned project and will have responsibility for coordinating: Design Planning Procurement Construction Quality Safety Cost Snagging Handover The position requires the individual to proactively identify project risks and delays and take timely corrective action in coordination with senior management and relevant stakeholders. Preferred Candidate Profile The preferred candidate is a hands-on construction professional who has successfully delivered residential and commercial building projects and can independently manage the complete project lifecycle. The candidate should combine strong technical construction knowledge with project planning, commercial awareness, contractor management, and leadership capabilities
